name: B10-0285/2025 (Renew) – Case of Ahmadreza Djalali in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Dr Ahmadreza Djalali in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling on Iran to cancel the death sentence against Dr. Ahmadreza Djalali, a Swedish-Iranian doctor held in prison since 2016, and to free him. It says he was tortured, denied proper medical care and sentenced after an unfair trial. It also asks Iran to release all detained European Union citizens, and asks European countries to push harder for their release and to consider sanctions.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament is asking Iran and European governments to act; it cannot order them to.
- **Who it affects:** Dr. Djalali, other detained European Union citizens, and Iran's government.
- **What happens next:** European diplomats are asked to raise his case with Iran, and the European Union may consider sanctions.
